name: Seino Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Seino Holdings Co., Ltd. provides transportation services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Transportation Services, Automotive Sales, Goods Sales, and Real Estate Leasing Services segments. It offers timed and cash on delivery/settlement services; charter delivery, letter and courier services, bicycle event and transport services, and bin services; and moving, shopping, and logistics services. The company also engages in the sale and repair of trucks, passenger cars, and automobile parts; and provision of shipping and office work support services, and reverse logistics/return management services.
